newsitem.title: ITALY: Chirac praises Italy for courageous policies.
newsitem.headline: Chirac praises Italy for courageous policies.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac on Friday said the centre-left Italian government appointed in May had adopted "courageos" economic policies that had helped strengthen the lira and cut interest rates.
Speaking at a joint news conference with Prime Minister Romano Prodi after a Franco-Italian summit, he said:
"The courageous policy of rigour adopted by the government is in line with the European spirit. The subsequent rise in the value of the lira and fall in interest rates can only be appreciated."
